column2: Describes the sub states of PN_IDLE and PN_ACTIVE, which helps in understanding local/remote activation of a PN. Based on the activation criteria, the PNC modes transition. When a PN is inactive (PN<n>_IDLE), SUM_PNC shall be set to PNC_ENABLE_CHECK. Once activation criteria is determined, SUM_PNC shall transition to PNC_MONITOR_ACTIVATION in case of local activation or to PNC_TX_ENABLE in case of remote activation.
